repos.name: JustVugg/colibri
repos.description: Run GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) on a 25GB-RAM consumer machine — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
repos.one_liner: A high-performance C-based inference engine designed to run massive 744B MoE models on consumer hardware.
bullets: Written in pure C with zero dependencies for maximum portability and minimal overhead.
Utilizes disk-streaming for model experts to bypass RAM limitations on consumer machines.
Enables local deployment of frontier-scale LLMs for privacy-sensitive financial analysis.
Optimized for high-throughput inference on constrained infrastructure.

repos.name: alibaba/open-code-review
repos.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.one_liner: A hybrid code review platform combining deterministic pipelines with LLM agents for enterprise-scale software quality.
bullets: Go-based architecture optimized for high-velocity development environments.
Integrates LLM agents to provide precise, line-level feedback on complex codebases.
Supports deterministic rule-based checking alongside intelligent semantic analysis.
Scalable infrastructure designed to enforce coding standards across large engineering teams.
